spec_evidence.checked: Cached snapshots, token-level with allOf resolution: NEW resolved subscriber props = {email_address, name, payer_id, payment_source, phone, shipping_address} (address, birth_date, tax_info gone). subscriber.name 7 props -> {given_name, surname}. shipping_address.name -> {full_name} only; shipping_address.address 10 -> 6 core portable fields. Inline plan echo in subscription 200: props lose id/status/create_time/update_time/links (7 survivors); top-level plan_id unchanged. phone.phone_number -> {national_number}. application_context.payment_method -> {payee_preferred}. revise 200 response: application_context key absent (OLD present); revise request application_context drops user_action only. transaction/capture payer_name keeps 6 name parts, drops alternate_full_name; status_details(.reason) absent in NEW transaction and capture 200 (status survives). Card request: OLD {billing_address, card_type, expiry, id, last_digits, name, number, security_code} -> NEW {attributes, billing_address, brand, expiry, name, number, security_code, type}. GET /v1/billing/plans params OLD [Prefer, product_id, plan_ids, page_size, page, total_required] -> NEW without plan_ids.

alternative_data_source: Per-plan lookup GET /v1/billing/plans/{id} and product_id list filtering remain available.

fix.migration_guide: The plan_ids query parameter was removed from GET /v1/billing/plans (token-verified; remaining params are product_id/page_size/page/total_required + Prefer header). To fetch specific plans, call GET /v1/billing/plans/{id} per plan, or list by product_id and filter client-side.
